strings.ttl.prologue_sub: The Era of the Silent Cycle. 174 years after Avatar Korra
strings.tut.move: Arrows — walk, Shift — run, Z — talk and examine
strings.tut.pipo: Pipo senses hidden things: glittering spots now show on maps
strings.tut.shrine: Shrines heal the party and save the game
strings.quest.dog.1: Toshi lost his platypus-dog Bagel. It seems he ran off to the hill.
strings.quest.dog.2: Bagel was found and ran home. Go see Toshi.
strings.quest.dog.reward: Bagel is home. Toshi gave you a luck charm.
strings.choice.dog_no: Sorry, Toshi, I'm in a hurry.
strings.choice.pipo_yes: Want to come with me, little one?
strings.choice.pipo_no: Go home to the forest. It's dangerous here.

pr.intro: isa:surprised|Where am I? I know this hall. I keep dreaming about it.
pr.korra: korra|Don't be afraid. You've been here before, you just don't remember.
isa:surprised|You're... Avatar Korra? I saw your portrait in my schoolbook!
korra:happy|A schoolbook? I hope they at least got my nose right.
korra|This is the Vault. Everyone you have been stands here. You used to be able to walk all the way back, to the very first flame.
korra:sad|Now the road breaks off. I'm the only one you can really call. Well, me and him.
isa|«Everyone I have been»? I never asked to be anyone.
korra|Nobody did. Go on, he's waiting further in.
pr.jinhai: jinhai|So, fire. After me came fire.
isa|You're Avatar Jinhai? They say you died at thirty-one. And nobody knows how.
jinhai:sad|I know. Knowing is what killed me.
jinhai|I listened to the silence, girl. Where our past lives should be speaking, it's quiet. Then the silence started listening to me.
isa:angry|You all speak in riddles! What am I supposed to do?
jinhai:angry|Don't go further. Whatever is there only pretends to be the past.
pr.echo: echo|We remember you. We remember all of you.
echo|You call it a cycle. To us it is a cage.
echo|Wake up, little flame. We are coming soon.
pr.wake: hana:angry|{player}! The sun's over the forge and you're still snoring like a badgermole!
hana:angry|Five minutes was an hour ago. Get down here, there's work!
pr.wake2: isa|That dream again. The Vault, Korra... and that voice.
isa:sad|Not a word to anyone. Especially now.
